text:
marie_ops: FYI vendor Lia just flagged a 40-unit H100 EU allocation delay, looks like ~2 week slip. Asking if we want expedited replacements or temporary loaners. PO 67890.
lia_vendor: Sorry about the hit — we saw a defective batch at QA. We can do 20 immediate loaners from our EMEA pool + ship the remaining after RMA clears, or full expedite air for replacements (extra cost). ETA options listed below.
marie_ops: Quick clarifying q — loaners routed through FRA or AMS? customs hold risk?
lia_vendor: Primary route FRA. We can pre-clear with HS code 8471.99, but customs may still request invoice amendment. Brokerage will be charged on our end if you want prepay option.
sanjay_procurement: What's the delta on cost for full expedite vs loaner? need numbers to OK.
lia_vendor: Ballpark: expedite air ~€1,600/unit (one-time shipping premium + priority handling). Loaners: €0 upfront, but refundable deposit €10k and broker fee ~€450 per shipment. We absorb RMA inbound sea cost.
oliver_infra: If we take loaners, can infra accept mixed-generation H100/ H100 NV? we need to tag to separate pools for rollout testing.
tom_network: Also note cross-region network uplink for loaners might be via our AMS AD, latency ok but ensure firmware parity.
marie_ops: Good catch — we can schedule a small canary on the loaners then roll to prod. Need ETA on serials for inventory.
lia_vendor: AWB for loaner shipment: `AWB: 948-5551230`. Expected FRA dock ETA 3 business days after clearance. Serial manifest attached to vendor portal (link).
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA# R-2026-4421 for defective batch, inbound ETA (vendor) 2026-06-12. Linked PO: 67890.
sanjay_procurement: If we accept loaners, what's the SLA for returning them after replacements arrive? we have contracts with budget owners.
lia_vendor: Standard 30-day loan period from handover, can extend at €75/unit/day. We can negotiate a 14-day extension free if expedite chosen for the replacements.
marie_ops: Can vendor prepay brokerage to reduce hold time? we prefer pre-clear to avoid stuck units at customs.
lia_vendor: Yes, we can prepay brokerage and supply a debit note to reconcile. Need written approval from procurement. ETA to pre-clear docs 6-8 hours.
tom_network: Any chance to route some replacements from APAC spare pool (faster air lanes) if cost + customs ok?
lia_vendor: APAC -> EU air is possible but customs re-import may trigger VAT reclaim complexity. We can provide a cost/clearance memo.
oliver_infra: Operational ask: if loaners arrive, label them `temp-loaner-2026` and add tag in our asset tracker so billing and telemetry exclude from cost analysis.
marie_ops: Agreed, please confirm deposit flow and account code for finance if we go loaner route.
sanjay_procurement: I'll approve prepay brokerage if vendor invoices match the quote. Marie, tag me once Lia sends final PO amendment.
lia_vendor: Will push amended PO and deposit invoice within 2 hours. If you want expedite instead, need sign-off today to catch the 00:00 UTC cutoff for next flight.
marie_ops: OK, leaning loaner+prepay brokerage to avoid flight premium. Sanjay please confirm procurement sign-off by EOD. I'll open a small playbook in #eng-ops for asset tagging and canary plan.
